name: Judicator Court
description: The Judicator Court is the center of Akhevan law and ritual judgment. Void‑arcane tribunals, Luclinite decree chambers, resonance‑aligned verdict altars, and Praesertum oversight halls define this district. Judicators interpret ancient decrees, enforce lineage law, and conduct ceremonial trials that bind civic order to void‑arcane resonance.
